segments.s1: Hee Daawit! Yeroo dheeraaf wal hin argine!
segments.s3: Hojii koo haaraa irratti baay'ee qabamee ture. Ati hoo?
segments.s4: Hamaa miti. Guyyaa hunda Afaan Ingiliffaa barachaa jira.
segments.s5: Baay'ee gaarii! Dhuma torban kanaa wal arginee haa haasofnu.

long_time_no_see.context: Nama yeroo dheeraaf hin argin yeroo argitu nagaa gammachuudhaan gaafachuuf jedhama. Liyaan Daawitin erga yeroo dheeraa booda waan argiteef gammaddee jirti.
long_time_no_see.example: Yeroo dheeraaf wal hin argine! Maatiin kee akkam jiru?

how_have_you_been.context: Erga wal argitan booda jireenyi akkam akka ture gaafachuuf. 'How are you?' haala amma qofa gaafata; kun immoo yeroo darbe illee ni dabalata.
how_have_you_been.example: Erga gara Adaamaa deemtee akkam turte?

what_about_you.context: Waa'ee ofii erga dubbattee booda, gaaffii walfakkaataa nama biraatiif deebisuuf. Liyaan waa'ee hojii ishee erga dubbattee booda Daawitin gaafatti.
what_about_you.example: Kubbaa miilaa nan jaalladha. Ati hoo?

not_bad.context: Wanti hundi gaarii akka ta'e salphaatti ibsuuf. Yeroo baay'ee 'gaarii dha' jechuu dha.
not_bad.example: Qormaanni akkam ture? Hamaa miti, galatoomi.

catch_up.context: Namoonni yeroo dheeraaf wal hin argin wal arganii oduu dabre waliif himuu. Asitti Liyaan Daawitin dhuma torbanii akka wal argan affeerti.
catch_up.example: Erga barnootaa booda wal arginee haa haasofnu.

sounds_good.context: Yaada dhiyaate irratti walii galuu agarsiisa. Daawit affeerraa Liyaa ni fudhata.

see_you_soon.context: Yeroo addaan baatan, dhiyootti akka wal argitan abdachuudhaan nagaa wal gaafachuuf jedhama.
